description: Deletes files from the Windows temp folder that are older than the cutoff.

fields.name: TargetFolder
fields.label: Folder to clean
fields.helpText: The temp folder this script cleans. Files older than the cutoff will be deleted from here.
fields.helpDetail: This is usually %TEMP% — Windows' temporary files. Files go to the Recycle Bin, so you can restore them. You can point this at another folder, but keep it to a temp-like location.

fields.name: CutoffDays
fields.label: Delete files older than
fields.helpText: Files in the temp folder older than this many days will be deleted.
fields.helpDetail: Based on last write time. Younger files are left alone. 7 days keeps recent temp files for apps that are still running.

fields.name: IgnoreFolders
fields.label: Folders to never delete from
fields.helpText: Files under these folders are never deleted, regardless of age.
fields.helpDetail: Each entry is a folder whose files this script will always keep — even old ones — including everything in its subfolders. Entries may use %VAR% paths and trailing slashes; matching ignores case. An entry outside the cleaned folder simply never matches. Folders that do not exist yet are fine — they apply if created later. This script only ever deletes files, never folders. Leave empty for today's behavior.
